# Split the tips fairly, to the cent, and show your staff the arithmetic.

> Free restaurant tip pool calculator: paste a shift list and split tips by hours, by role points or by server tip-out. Card fee, owner and manager exclusion, payroll CSV. Private, runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
